name: bash
description: Execute a bash command on the workstation and return its output. Use absolute paths; working directory does not persist between calls. Set run_in_background for long-running commands.

name: read_file
description: Read a file (text, image, or PDF) from the filesystem. Returns numbered lines. Use offset/limit for large files.

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content.

name: edit_file
description: Exact string replacement in an existing file. old_string must match uniquely; set replace_all to replace every occurrence.

name: glob
description: Find files by glob pattern (e.g. **/*.org), sorted by modification time.

path.description: Directory to search from (default: working directory)

name: grep
description: Search file contents with a regex (ripgrep). Returns matching lines with file and line number.

path.description: File or directory to search (default: working directory)

glob_filter.description: Restrict to files matching this glob

context_lines.description: Lines of context around each match

name: spawn_agent
description: Launch a subagent with its own context to handle a delegated task; returns the subagent's final report. Subagent sessions are traced to Langfuse like any other session on this machine.

task.description: Full task prompt for the subagent

model.description: Model to run it on: opus | sonnet | fable | haiku (default opus)

effort.description: Reasoning effort: low | medium | high | xhigh | max

run_in_background.description: Do not block on the result; a completion notification arrives later

name: publish_artifact
description: Render a self-contained HTML file to a private web page the principal can open from any device. Re-publishing the same path updates the same URL.

path.description: Absolute path to the HTML file

title.description: Page title shown to the principal

name: message_principal
description: Send a short message to the principal's phone. He may be away or asleep; use for genuine blockers or decisions only he can make, otherwise keep working and report at the end.
